Authorities have now launched an investigation to trace those responsible.According to reports, the incident came to light while Kirti was at a multiplex near Fun Republic Mall in Andheri West, Mumbai. The unexpected notification immediately raised concerns, as the actress had not authorized any such payment.Realizing the transaction appeared suspicious, Kirti is said to have contacted her bank's customer care helpline without delay. title: How the Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme could make India a global electronics manufacturing hub
text: India's new Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme prioritses scale and exports. This strategy aims to build a robust electronics manufacturing ecosystem. Domestic value addition naturally follows sustained manufacturing growth and scale. The government expects significant production and export figures by FY31. This policy shift focuses on total economic value creation within India.

title: Yi Long Court Review: Timeless Cantonese fine dining at The Peninsula Shanghai
text: Yi Long Court at The Peninsula Shanghai provides a glamorous 1930s atmosphere. The kitchen delivers unapologetic Cantonese perfection with traditional techniques. Lunchtime dim sum is an absolute must-order for diners. Main courses feature smoky tea-infused chicken and crispy beef brisket. Desserts like almond cream and papaya with bird's nest conclude the meal.

title: Where have Bollywood's next generation of superstars gone?
text: The film industry currently lacks new movie superstars, a notable shift from past trends. Existing stars like Prabhas and Allu Arjun are active, while the Khans show diminishing returns. The rise of streaming and smaller screens has made megastar emergence difficult. Korean dramas and Marvel content also compete for audience attention. The traditional superstar role now often resembles an influencer or politician.

title: Sophisticated simplicity
text: Sophisticated simplicity involves performing actions with depth and elegance. It blends technology and nature creatively with zeal and involvement. Japanese artisans excel in integrating nature and technology seamlessly. Clarity and precision are crucial elements in communication and dealing with people. Simple practices and few needs make life worthwhile and expressions deep.

title: So, what board are you on? Every board is different — directors who adapt to the one they join create more value
text: Independent directors must understand their specific board's archetype for optimal performance. Four archetypes exist: promoter-led, MNC subsidiary, private equity, and widely-held. Each board structure demands different director preparation and success definitions. Nominating committees should match individuals to the appropriate board archetype. Clarifying roles and expectations enhances board effectiveness and director impact.

title: Factory floors find their footing again
text: India's industrial rejuvenation thrives on the backs of electronics and automotive sectors, driving economic vitality forward. The manufacturing sector saw remarkable growth in June, bolstered by diminishing global tensions. Enhanced performance in capital goods is a clear signal of increasing investment and industrial credit. With strategic reforms and infrastructure enhancement, India is poised to reshape its manufacturing landscape, aiming to elevate its GDP contribution.

title: No, we can't keep being like this only
text: In India, casual corruption has become a normalized part of everyday life, often embraced as a clever workaround known as 'jugaad.' This acceptance erodes institutional trust and perpetuates social disparities. While enforcing anti-corruption laws rolls back this deeply-rooted behavior, it faces challenges from cultural resistance. For any meaningful governance reform, it’s essential to challenge and delegitimize corruption as a social practice.

title: How AI is helping pharma prevent drug recalls, counter fakes and improve patient safety
text: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing the pharmaceutical sector by significantly reducing the instances of drug recalls. By improving supply chain efficiency, AI ensures that medicine stocks are adequately maintained, facilitating prompt deliveries.

title: More than meets eyes
text: The Allusionist podcast episode Hues examines the difficulty of defining colors. Helen Zaltzman and Kory Stamper discuss historical and modern linguistic puzzles. Dictionary makers have long struggled to define colors using only words. This episode reveals the complexity behind seemingly obvious color definitions. It offers a fascinating journey through language, history, and perception.

title: India's Ahimsa indices mark beginning of a new era in ethical investing
text: Indian stock exchanges have launched new ethically-anchored indices. These indices align with indigenous values like ahimsa and saatvik principles. They offer investors a rules-based approach to ethical portfolio alignment. Companies gain credibility and attract ethically motivated capital through inclusion. This innovation reflects a growing global trend in values-based investing.

title: MV Electrosystems IPO: Issue received a solid response on Day 01, booked 3.9 times; GMP signals bumper listing
text: MV Electrosystems IPO on July 30 saw strong demand, with bids for 1.45 crore shares, resulting in a 3.87 times subscription. Retail investors led at 12.68 times, while QIBs subscribed at 0.87 times. The listing is expected on August 06 with a grey market premium of ₹120.

title: Crude oil prices drop as reports of Iran-Oman Hormuz talks temper supply fears
text: Crude oil prices fell on 30 July, with Brent dipping below $90 and WTI below $83, as talks between Iran and Oman over the Strait of Hormuz progress despite renewed US strikes on Iran.

title: Microsoft jumps over 15% after results, Meta sinks 9% as AI concerns weigh investor sentiment — What we know
text: Microsoft stock jumped close to 12% following the software major's earnings announcement today, while tech giant Meta saw its shares slump 9% on the back of its results, according to reports.

title: Mazagon Dock Q1 results: Net profit rises 22% YoY to ₹550 crore; revenue up 12%
text: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders reported a consolidated net profit of ₹550 crore for Q1 FY27, a 22% increase from ₹452 crore last year, but lower than ₹674 crore in Q4. Revenue rose 12% year-on-year to ₹2,943 crore, although it fell 26% sequentially.

title: Juniper Green Energy IPO booked 38% on Day 1; QIB portion fully subscribed
text: Juniper Green Energy's IPO showed weak demand on its opening day, with a subscription rate of 0.38 times. The qualified institutional buyers exhibited the strongest interest, while retail and non-institutional investors showed low participation.

title: US stock market today: Wall Street futures recover from Fed-led losses; Microsoft jumps 10%
text: US stock futures rose on Thursday, led by technology gains, despite ongoing Middle East tensions. Microsoft surged 10% on strong cloud growth, while Meta fell 10%.

title: Vedanta Q1 results: Profit rises 72% YoY to ₹5,473 crore; names new CEO, announces real estate business demerger
text: Vedanta reported a 71.8% YoY rise in its consolidated profit (attributable to the owners of the company) to ₹5,473 crore for Q1FY27. Its total revenue from operations rose 53.6% YoY to ₹24,205 crore.

title: Swiggy Q1 results: Net loss narrows to ₹791 crore; revenue jumps 37% YoY
text: Swiggy reported a net loss of ₹791 crore for Q1 FY27, an improvement from ₹1,197 crore in Q1 FY26. Revenue surged 54% YoY to ₹6,812 crore, bolstered by growth in quick commerce, up from ₹4,961 crore in the same quarter last year.

title: Bajaj Finance Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 27% to ₹5,986 crore; NII up 23%
text: Bajaj Finance Ltd. reported strong Q1 FY27 earnings with a 27.4% YoY rise in net profit to ₹5,986 crore, exceeding estimates. Net interest income rose 23% YoY to ₹12,571 crore, while AUM increased 23% YoY to ₹4,00,389 crore, despite declining asset quality.

title: Top Gainers & Losers on 30 July: Redington, Swiggy, Hero MotoCorp, Syrma SGS Tech, Exide among top gainers
text: The Indian stock market remained range-bound on July 30, amid fragile investor sentiment and escalating Middle East tensions. The Nifty 50 gained 0.35%, while broader indices declined. U.S. Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged, with inflation concerns prompting discussions on tighter policies.
